page: Microsoft Azure E104id_v5 is an isolated, memory-optimized instance powered by dedicated Intel Xeon Platinum 8370C processors operating at 2.8 GHz. Delivering 104 vCPUs across 52 physical cores with hyper-threading, the server incorporates 48 KB of L1 data cache, 1 MB of L2 cache, and 48 MB of shared L3 cache. Vector processing capabilities include AVX, AVX-512F, and AVX-512 VNNI, accompanied by hardware cryptographic extensions such as VAES and SHA-NI.

The instance is provisioned with 672.0 GB of system memory, yielding 6.46 GB per vCPU, and integrates 4,080 GB of local SSD temporary storage. There are no discrete GPUs attached. Memory subsystem testing reflects strong sustained throughput, registering 332.17 GB/sec in large-block read operations and 133.10 GB/sec during large-block writes. Furthermore, the local NVMe-class storage combined with massive RAM supports high-throughput in-memory caching and transactional workloads, reflected in Redis benchmark throughput reaching 93.76 million SET operations per second and strong database operations testing.

Computational benchmarks demonstrate a clear profile: multi-threaded performance scores in the top 25% across stress-ng (100,873.26) and PassMark (79,912.64), with cryptographic testing reaching the top 10% tier. Conversely, single-threaded execution on both Geekbench and stress-ng falls within the median range. In terms of cost efficiency relative to its footprint, the dedicated full-host allocation and bundled 4,080 GB SSD eliminate the need for supplementary ephemeral drives for scratch disks, though low per-core LLM text generation rates indicate the CPU architecture is inefficient for large model generation tasks.

The hardware configuration is suitable for large-scale enterprise databases, SAP HANA and in-memory caches, distributed analytics engines, high-concurrency compilation tasks, and heavy transactional backend systems requiring host isolation and high memory density.
description: Microsoft Azure E104id_v5 is a high-capacity, isolated memory-optimized instance featuring 104 dedicated vCPUs (52 physical cores) powered by 2.8 GHz Intel Xeon 8370C processors with AVX-512 support. Configured with 672.0 GB of memory (6.46 GB per core) and bundled with 4,080 GB of local SSD storage, the instance excludes discrete GPUs. Benchmark results indicate exceptional multi-core computational throughput, high memory bandwidth (332.17 GB/sec large read), and top-tier cryptographic performance, alongside Redis processing exceeding 93 million operations per second. While single-thread execution and large-parameter language model generation remain median-to-weak, the large RAM allocation and high I/O local disk density deliver balanced resource efficiency for memory-bound applications. The E104id_v5 is engineered for relational and in-memory databases, memory-heavy analytics pipelines, and large-scale enterprise services.
